title: Pattern Visualizer
description: A full-stack 3D app built for my clothing brand (SEVR) to preview fabric patterns on a pants model with tiling, scale and lighting controls, as well as PNG export, saved presets, and shareable read-only links.

title: Terrain Amplification Pipeline
description: A terrain processing pipeline exploring multi-scale amplification and erosion-style operators on heightfields, with controllable parameters and a focus on visual quality, inspired by Schott et al.

title: Neurofeedback EEG Simulator
description: A neurofeedback EEG device simulator built with C++ and Qt to demonstrate core user flows and real-time brainwave visualization.
